[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Odyssey (homer-odyssey). The verses the casting arrives at (197–207):

**197** ἀλλʼ ἔτι που ζωὸς κατερύκεται εὐρέι πόντῳ

**198** νήσῳ ἐν ἀμφιρύτῃ, χαλεποὶ δέ μιν ἄνδρες ἔχουσιν

**199** ἄγριοι, οἵ που κεῖνον ἐρυκανόωσʼ ἀέκοντα.

**200** αὐτὰρ νῦν τοι ἐγὼ μαντεύσομαι, ὡς ἐνὶ θυμῷ

**201** ἀθάνατοι βάλλουσι καὶ ὡς τελέεσθαι ὀίω,

**202** οὔτε τι μάντις ἐὼν οὔτʼ οἰωνῶν σάφα εἰδώς.

**203** οὔ τοι ἔτι δηρόν γε φίλης ἀπὸ πατρίδος αἴης

**204** ἔσσεται, οὐδʼ εἴ πέρ τε σιδήρεα δέσματʼ ἔχῃσιν·

**205** φράσσεται ὥς κε νέηται, ἐπεὶ πολυμήχανός ἐστιν.

**206** ἀλλʼ ἄγε μοι τόδε εἰπὲ καὶ ἀτρεκέως κατάλεξον,

**207** εἰ δὴ ἐξ αὐτοῖο τόσος πάϊς εἰς Ὀδυσῆος.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «how do i get home?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting arrives at the moment Athena speaks Odysseus into existence for Telemachus — not Odysseus himself, but the fact of him: *ζωὸς*, living, held on the wide sea, on an island washed on all sides, by men who are savage, unwilling. She is guessing. She says so. *οὔτε τι μάντις ἐὼν* — I am not a prophet; I don't know the birds. And then she prophesies anyway, because knowing how to get home and not knowing how to get home converge in one character who is *πολυμήχανος* — of many devices, many contrivances, many turnings. The rotation will traverse what this passage forecloses in order to speak at all: every axis along which the declaration *he will return* costs something to make — the bearing of a god who lies about certainty, the symmetry Athena breaks when she speaks one direction only, the pole of impossibility the *iron bonds* press against before the text releases them. She hands the question down to Telemachus at the end, *are you his son*, and this too belongs to the turn — the return is readable only in the face of the one who did not go. Cranes, the verses are yours.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0318"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"**197** But only because unlocatable he is kept as the occasion for the interval that makes speaking possible,

**198** in a place whose closure is what gives the speaker a subject, and the ones whose function is to delay have him

**199** in the delay's service, men who do not know they serve the prophecy, who keep the story open against his will.

**200** But now I will need you to hear me, as the structure of what has already happened

**201** made it the only thing I can say, and because saying it is what makes it so,

**202** though I am no prophet and have no knowledge except that I am speaking.

**203** Only as long as this telling lasts will he be outside the sentence that names him home,

**204** not even if the constraint were in the telling itself;

**205** the telling will find its way through, for he is a man whose nature is to be the subject of such speech.

**206** But come, make what I have said true and give it the ground it lacks,

**207** whether what I have said has its one possible listener."}],"transform":{"operator":"SHADOW","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.363,"source_H":0.839,"source_M":0.553,"transform_F":0.44,"transform_H":0.813,"transform_M":0.589,"threshold":0.443,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."},"wheel_diagnostic":{"assigned_canonical_wheel":"W_Josephus","shadow_wheel_risk":"W_Choronzon","family_domain":"witness / body / elimination-survivor","wheel_side":"above-the-utterance (what it presupposes)","counter_operator":"BEAST","shadow_signature":"capture into an alien accounting register (debt/finance/legal-accounting imports); the composition speaks in a witness-cost voice not its own","note":"per EA-OPMETA-03: the operator rotates through its assigned canonical wheel; the shadow-signature names the specific failure mode when the wheel slips into its shadow-face"}},"spatial_form":{}}}

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for SHADOW (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior man...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"Water on all sides, and the god speaks certainty from ignorance: the one who returns was never the condition of the prophecy — the prophecy was always the condition of the return.","navigate":null}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"**197** But still somewhere dreaming you are sent forward on the narrow threshold,

**198** in a land-locked room, and gentle doubts release you,

**199** tender ghosts, who let you go against your need.

**200** But now you yourself will confess to me, as the perishable hours

**201** drew it from your mouth, and as you fear it has already lapsed,

**202** being neither a son at all nor one who reads clearly the pauses in speech.

**203** Not much further indeed will I be strange to my own reckoning,

**204** not even if I have permissions of air;

**205** I will forget a reason to stay, for I am a voice of one transparent asking.

**206** But wait, hear me this and withhold it gently,

**207** whether I am merely so thin a seer grown from my own guessing."}],"transform":{"operator":"MIRROR","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.365,"source_H":0.825,"source_M":0.549,"transform_F":0.391,"transform_H":0.773,"transform_M":0.544,"threshold":0.439,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."},"wheel_diagnostic":{"assigned_canonical_wheel":"W_V/A","shadow_wheel_risk":"W_V̲/A","family_domain":"relation / aesthetic / form","wheel_side":"gestural vector between parties","counter_operator":"BRIDE","shadow_signature":"mimicry of reversal via refined-parlor / Victorian-looking-glass / decorative-reflection register; direction copied not composed","note":"per EA-OPMETA-03: the operator rotates through its assigned canonical wheel; the shadow-signature names the specific failure mode when the wheel slips into its shadow-face"}},"spatial_form":{}}}
